address: 89 Ton That Dam, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Chef Peter Cuong Franklin's retro-1960s cocktail bar above MICHELIN-starred Anan, built on Vietnam's nhau (drinking-snack) culture; Asia's 50 Best Discovery listed.
dish: pho mojito and rice-spirit cocktails garnished with Dalat lavender

address: 20 Mac Thi Buoi, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Hidden second-floor whisky-and-cocktail bar styled after a classic Tokyo whisky den, with several hundred single malts and bespoke cocktails; a Tatler Asia pick.
dish: bespoke made-to-taste cocktails and rare single-malt whisky

address: 138 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Subterranean Alice-in-Wonderland speakeasy (with upstairs Angels' Share) of internationally-trained bartenders, jazz nights and an Asia's-50-Best pop-up series; a Tatler Asia pick.

address: 41 Nguyen Van Trang, Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Speakeasy entered through two red London phone booths (lift the receiver to unlock the door) into a pre-war-London room of leather and mahogany; Asia's 50 Best Discovery listed.

address: 63/1 Pasteur, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: New-York-style split-level speakeasy down an alleyway, all raw industrial walls and reclaimed lighting, drawing a young crowd for exemplary drinks; Asia's 50 Best Discovery listed.

address: 28/3A Ton That Tung, Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Prohibition-inspired alley speakeasy (est. 2016) with the biggest gin collection in Vietnam and 24 house gin infusions; credited with sparking Saigon's gin revival.

address: 2 Lam Son Square (Park Hyatt Saigon), Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Park Hyatt Saigon's martini bar and one of the city's cocktail landmarks, running guest shifts with bartenders drawn from the World's Best Bars.

address: 8A Dang Tat, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Vietnam's pioneering hidden whisky bar, 600+ rare bottles curated by two collectors across intimate candlelit alcoves; named to Tatler Best Vietnam 2025.
dish: rare single-malt Scotch and bourbon flights

address: 39/22 Nguyen Trai, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Vietnam's first natural-wine bar (opened 2022), a tucked-away District 1 corner run by a Vietnamese sommelier with a low-intervention list.
dish: low-intervention natural wines by the glass

address: 63 Xuan Thuy, Thao Dien Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Thao Dien wine bar from a Danish sommelier-chef couple, one of Saigon's biggest by-the-glass and bottle lists (old-world focus) with classic charcuterie.
dish: old-world wines by the glass with charcuterie

address: AB Tower, 76A Le Lai, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The city's highest open-air rooftop bar on the 26th-27th floors of AB Tower, a 900sqm space with 360-degree skyline views, cocktails and a club sound system.

address: Hotel des Arts Saigon, 76-78 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai, Vo Thi Sau Ward, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Rooftop bar and infinity pool on the 23rd-24th floors of the elegant Hotel des Arts, a stylish sunset-to-late spot over the District 3 skyline.

address: Caravelle Saigon, 19-23 Lam Son Square, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Historic 10th-floor rooftop bar atop the Caravelle Hotel, a wartime haunt of diplomats and correspondents since 1959, with live music and skyline views.

address: 144/3 Pasteur, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The alley taproom where Saigon's craft-beer story began in 2015; 70+ recipes built on Vietnamese ingredients (jasmine, passionfruit, cacao), pioneers of the scene.
dish: Jasmine IPA and Passionfruit Wheat Ale

address: 31D Ly Tu Trong, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Conrad-themed brewery-taproom (est. 2016) with 20 rotating taps of bold, hop-forward beers; one of Saigon's most awarded craft breweries.

address: 181-185 Ly Tu Trong, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Saigon's first in-house brewpub concept, a large downtown brewery-and-kitchen turning out an approachable core range with local twists.
dish: Far East IPA and Independence Coffee Vanilla Porter

address: 1 Le Ngo Cat, Ward 7, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Collaborative craft-beer house pouring nearly 50 Vietnamese beers on tap alongside gastropub food; a hub of the local brewing community.
dish: rotating taps of Vietnamese craft beer

address: 50 Dang Thi Nhu, Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Art-Deco-Indochine taproom near Bui Vien over three levels to a rooftop terrace, brewing approachable styles with Southeast Asian ingredients and local collaborations.
dish: lemongrass blonde ale and easy-drinking lagers

address: 40 Bui Vien, Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Casual Bui Vien taproom of an entirely-Vietnamese brand (est. 2015) built for easy drinking rather than transplanted US craft culture.

address: 90 Nguyen Van Thu, Da Kao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Da Kao taproom of one of Saigon's early homegrown breweries (est. 2015), pairing eight house beers with a relaxed Vietnamese-tapas dining room.

address: 220A Nguyen Cong Tru, Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A colonial-shophouse coffee experience space and roastery telling Vietnam's 160-year coffee story; signature phin, filter and espresso blends plus cold brew and cascara.
dish: signature Vietnamese phin and filter blends

address: 103bis Vo Thi Sau, Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Specialty coffeehouse and in-house roastery (est. 2018) in a restored 1950s house, with a garden-linked Blue in Green roasting room you can watch at work.

address: 40/8 Pham Viet Chanh, Ward 19, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Cafe of Building, the Will Frith co-roasting hub and consultancy behind much of Saigon's specialty scene; precise brews from a serious roasting operation.
dish: single-origin filter and espresso from Building's roastery
